no_weighting: z=h_k instead of beta*h_k. Spatial distance weighting and modality fusion retained. Beta branch still receives original auxiliary losses, but is disconnected from downstream z.
no_modality: Replace the entire modality-specific stems plus shared fusion module in BOTH branches with the pre-existing mixed-input VisibleGraphEncoder. Spatial mean/max/sum, distance bandwidths, beta multiplication and prototypes retained. Not just removal of the shared residual.
no_prototype: Remove EMA teacher, prototypes, prototype consistency AND its variance regularizer; retain both branches and beta multiplication. Joint auxiliary-module ablation, not separate attribution to the two losses.
full: Use the same three selected GWFM checkpoints and independently selected full 48D downstream MLPs under the complete observed-region cohorts.
training: Same two mixed observation-only modality masks, train-only normalization, Adam0.001, cosine300, clip5, checkpoint by fixed validation Huber.
evaluation: Regional target-excluded interpolation using every naturally observed region in each split, plus two health-burden inference targets. No additional random downstream views. Freeze outputs before test scoring; retain the original three ablation definitions.
uncertainty: Mean and sample SD over three encoder seeds; fixed geography and decoder seed. Not significance or geographic replication.
